```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r load packages}

#load required packages
library(ggplot2)

```

```{r read in data}

#read in preprocessed data from intermediate data directory
penguins_na_omit <- read.csv("../data/intermediate/f01_preprocess_penguins/penguins_na_omit.csv")

```

```{r make plot}

#create plot from intermediate data
penguins_plot <- ggplot(penguins_na_omit, aes(x = Body.Mass..g., y = Flipper.Length..mm., color= Species)) +
                        geom_point()

```

```{r save analysis}

#save final result to analysis directory 
ggsave("../results/f02_plot_penguins/penguins_plot.png")

```
